description: Create one short link on linkbit.live for a destination URL. Returns the short URL and the link id. Optional UTM fields are merged into the destination without overwriting utm_* params it already has; a #fragment is kept. Fails on an invalid or unsafe URL, a slug that is taken, or when the daily create limit is reached.

destination.description: Full http(s) URL to redirect to.

note.description: Private note for your own reference. Not shown to visitors.

slug.description: Custom slug for the short URL. A random one is used when omitted.

utm_campaign.description: UTM campaign name. Added to the destination URL.

utm_content.description: UTM content (ad or link variant). Added to the destination URL.

utm_medium.description: UTM medium, e.g. email. Added to the destination URL.

utm_source.description: UTM source, e.g. newsletter. Added to the destination URL.

utm_term.description: UTM term (paid keyword). Added to the destination URL.

name: shorten_url
